services.name: LEARNto Sail
services.desc: From early May through October, you can find the Back Bay Skippers racing radio-controlled model yachts every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon along the Cotton Valley Rail-Trail on Back Bay in Wolfeboro. This is a lively, competitive group of men, women, and children of all ages. The Back Bay Skippers were established in 2008, with the assistance of the New Hampshire Boat Museum (NHBM) and the Laconia Model Yacht Club, to promote radio controlled sailing in the Wolfeboro area. Their mission is to build and sail a fleet of sailboats, while providing participants and spectators an avenue to enjoy this hobby.
